headline: Switch Sports Resort is coming!
title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort Release Date October 22 | Switch 2 Exclusive | Gaming News
video_script: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort is coming exclusively to Nintendo Switch 2 on October twenty second, twenty twenty six. It is a new motion-controlled sports party game, with bowling, golf, tennis, archery, basketball, skateboarding and even more activities. Many of them use the Switch 2 motion and mouse controls. Perfect for playing with friends and family. Which sport will you try first? Comment below!
description: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort launches October 22, 2026 exclusively on Nintendo Switch 2 - bowling, golf, tennis, archery, basketball, skateboarding and more.
